## Section 1 — Scope of Supply

Veracier Defence & Securite S.A.S. shall supply to Aurelia Defence S.p.A. the products and services described in the Technical Schedule.

#### Section 2 — Term

This Agreement shall be for an initial term of five (5) years from the Effective Date.

## Section 3 — Pricing

Prices are as set forth in the Pricing Schedule.

### Section 4 — Delay Penalties

Late deliveries shall be subject to liquidated damages of 0.5% per week, capped at 10%.

### Section 5 — Warranty

Supplier warrants all Products against defects in design, materials, and workmanship for twenty-four (24) months from delivery.

#### Section 6 — Liability

Supplier's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed two (2) times the annual contract value.

#### Section 7 — Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of England and Wales.

A review of cross-indemnity provisions among Group entities has been initiated to determine which entity bears the ultimate financial burden of the litigation.

The conclusions of this legal analysis are subject to legal professional privilege and must not be disclosed to third parties without the prior approval of the General Counsel.

--- Page 2 ---

The cost plus method has been applied to contract manufacturing activities, with an 8% markup on direct and indirect production costs.

A conflict-of-interest check has been performed to ensure that the appointed external counsel does not rep

[...evidence excerpt...]

reof upon request.

The manufacturing routing comprises 9 principal operations from material cutting (Op 10) to final inspection and release (Op 90). Each operation requires operator sign-off and quality verification.

The Customer reserves the right to audit the Supplier's facilities, records, and quality management systems upon fifteen (15) business days' prior written notice, to verify compliance with this Agreement.

The supplier audit report identified three (3) major non-conformities relating to forging process control and raw material traceability. A corrective action plan with deadlines has been demanded.

The provision has been measured in accordance with IAS 37, based on the best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the obligation at the reporting date, discounted at a risk-free rate of 3.2%.

The provision movement schedule shows a net charge of EUR 3.2 million for the year, primarily driven by litigation provisions (+EUR 1.8M) and restructuring provisions (+EUR 1.4M).

Part marking includes: lot number, part number, serial number, date of manufacture, and inspector stamp. Marking is performed by micro-percussion per customer specification.

The comparability analysis was performed using the Bureau van Dijk / TP Catalyst database, selecting comparable companies based on functions performed, assets employed, and risks assumed (FAR analysis).

--- Page 3 ---

Year-end accruals include the following items: customer delay penalties (EUR 2.1M), product warrant

generation_archetype.label: Contracts, clauses, obligations, and regulatory legal review
generation_archetype.focus: parties, clauses, obligations, rights, scope, exceptions, dates, and governing restrictions
perfect_guidance: Use clause-level obligations or restrictions explicitly stated in the contract evidence.
Keep the answer about what the clause says, not a broader legal conclusion unless the text states it.
ambiguous_guidance: Use one supported clause or obligation.
Pair it with one unresolved limitation about applicability, exception coverage, counterparty scope, or missing schedule.
wrong_guidance: Invert a clause, assign it to the wrong party, change the scope, or invent consent/termination rights.
Do not include any source ids for unsupported legal claims.
